subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: Should Discord voice owners accept account-scoped @discordjs/voice groups plus 6s/8s/75s delayed autoJoin retries after the branch is refreshed and focused tests are updated?
rationale: The change fixes a real multi-account failure mode, but it intentionally changes Discord voice session ownership and startup timing, which green CI alone cannot fully settle.

options.title: Refresh And Prove The Voice Contract
options.body: Resolve the dirty branch, update the focused ready/resumed and group-key tests, and re-check the Discord voice path before merge.

options.title: Accept The Timing Tradeoff
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the delayed retry schedule after owner review confirms startup, leave, and rejoin behavior is desired.

options.title: Pause Or Replace If It Cannot Be Reproven
options.body: If the multi-account Discord voice scenario cannot be shown again after refresh, pause or replace this PR rather than landing timing-sensitive churn.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Prove The Voice Contract
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty branch, update the focused ready/resumed and group-key tests, and re-check the Discord voice path before merge.
